description: 20 factuality queries (15 EN + 5 VI) for Tuần 4; 3–5 atomic gold claims each. Judge: supported / contradicted / unsupported vs final report. Topics align with configs/seed_corpus.yaml + ingested blogs (ADR-029).

items.query: What is retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and why is it used for knowledge-intensive NLP tasks?
gold_claims: RAG retrieves external documents or passages at query time to condition the language model.
RAG aims to ground generation in non-parametric knowledge rather than relying only on weights stored in the model.
RAG is especially relevant when tasks require factual knowledge that may be missing or stale in the base model.
The standard RAG setup typically couples a retriever with a text generator for open-domain QA-style tasks.

items.query: How does Self-RAG improve over naive always-retrieve pipelines?
gold_claims: Self-RAG can learn when to retrieve versus generate without retrieval.
Self-RAG includes self-critique mechanisms that judge whether retrieval and generations are helpful.
Self-RAG belongs to the broader family of retrieval-augmented large language model methods.
Self-RAG uses reflection-style signals during generation rather than a single fixed retrieve-then-read policy.

items.query: What does a typical RAG survey taxonomy cover for large language systems?
gold_claims: RAG surveys usually organize stages such as retrieval, knowledge integration, and generation.
Modern RAG systems often discuss trade-offs between sparse retrieval, dense retrieval, and hybrid designs.
Survey papers frame RAG as a modular stack rather than a monolithic model.

items.query: What is LoRA and how does it change the cost of fine-tuning large language models?
gold_claims: LoRA adds trainable low-rank matrices to selected weight matrices while keeping most pretrained weights frozen.
LoRA reduces the number of trainable parameters compared with full fine-tuning of all weights.
LoRA updates are structured as low-rank adaptation layers rather than dense full-rank updates everywhere.
LoRA is widely used as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning technique for transformers.
LoRA targets adaptation of attention or feed-forward linear maps with a small rank budget.

items.query: What is QLoRA and why does it matter for fine-tuning very large models?
gold_claims: QLoRA fine-tunes a language model with a 4-bit quantized base model in typical configurations.
QLoRA keeps memory footprint lower than full-precision fine-tuning of the same architecture size.
QLoRA stacks low-rank adapters on top of the quantized backbone during training.
QLoRA is positioned as an efficient finetuning recipe for quantized LLMs.

items.query: Explain the ReAct pattern for LLM agents and how it differs from reasoning alone.
gold_claims: ReAct interleaves reasoning traces with actions that can use external tools or an environment.
ReAct is designed so the model can observe feedback after actions before continuing reasoning.
ReAct differs from pure chain-of-thought that never commits to concrete environment actions.
The ReAct paradigm is used to build agents that plan and act in multiple steps.

items.query: What is Self-Refine for language models?
gold_claims: Self-Refine is an iterative refinement approach where the model critiques and revises its own outputs.
Self-Refine relies on multi-pass generation rather than a single-shot answer only.
Self-Refine frames improvement as a feedback loop from the model to itself.

items.query: What is notable about Llama 2 as an open foundation model release?
gold_claims: Llama 2 was released with open weights for research and commercial use under a custom license.
The Llama 2 technical report describes both base and chat-tuned model families.
Llama 2 belongs to the Llama family of large autoregressive transformer language models.
Llama 2 was positioned as an openly available alternative to closed proprietary chat models at launch.

items.query: What distinguishes DeepSeek-R1 style training for reasoning models?
gold_claims: DeepSeek-R1 emphasizes strengthening reasoning capability in large language models.
DeepSeek-R1 training leverages reinforcement-learning-style incentives for reasoning behavior.
DeepSeek-R1 is part of the DeepSeek model line focused on advanced reasoning.
DeepSeek-R1 aims to produce chain-like reasoning outputs competitive with frontier reasoning systems.

items.query: What is Graph RAG in the Microsoft GraphRAG line of work for summarization?
gold_claims: Graph RAG builds a graph-structured index over source content to support retrieval and summarization.
The Graph RAG approach targets query-focused summarization with global and local views of a corpus.
Graph RAG connects text units via a knowledge graph rather than only flat chunk retrieval.
Graph RAG is designed to improve coverage on holistic questions about large document collections.

items.query: What is Constitutional AI and how does it use AI feedback?
gold_claims: Constitutional AI trains models toward harmlessness with synthetic AI feedback.
Constitutional AI uses a written constitution of principles to steer critique and revision.
Constitutional AI reduces reliance solely on human labels for every harmful example.
Constitutional AI is an alignment technique associated with Anthropic’s research.

items.query: How does Anthropic contextual retrieval change chunk embeddings?
gold_claims: Contextual retrieval prepends chunk-specific explanatory context before embedding the chunk.
The goal is to reduce ambiguity when isolated chunks lack surrounding document context.
Anthropic positions contextual retrieval as improving vector search for RAG pipelines.

items.query: What do OpenAI structured outputs guarantee for API developers?
gold_claims: Structured outputs are designed to match a developer-supplied JSON schema.
Structured outputs reduce malformed JSON compared with free-form completion alone.
Structured outputs help tool-calling and typed downstream parsing in agent systems.

items.query: What problem does LangGraph solve for LangChain agents?
gold_claims: LangGraph models agent control flow as a cyclic graph over states.
LangGraph supports persistence and human-in-the-loop breakpoints in workflows.
LangGraph allows branching and loops that pure DAG chains struggle to express cleanly.
LangGraph is a framework layered on LangChain for building stateful agents.

items.query: What does the Hugging Face Ray RAG blog cover?
gold_claims: The article discusses scaling retrieval-augmented generation pipelines with Ray.
It connects Hugging Face tooling with distributed Ray compute for RAG workloads.
It targets practitioners building production-style RAG systems beyond a single machine.

items.query: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) là gì và vì sao quan trọng với LLM?
gold_claims: RAG truy xuất tài liệu bên ngoài tại thời điểm truy vấn để bổ sung ngữ cảnh cho mô hình.
RAG giúp giảm ảo giác factual bằng cách neo câu trả lời vào nguồn được truy xuất.
RAG thường kết hợp bước retrieval với bước sinh văn bản của LLM.
RAG phù hợp khi kiến thức cần cập nhật hoặc không nằm hết trong trọng số mô hình.

items.query: So sánh ngắn gọn LoRA và QLoRA cho fine-tuning LLM.
gold_claims: LoRA huấn luyện ma trận hạng thấp gắn vào một số tầng trong khi đóng băng phần lớn trọng số gốc.
QLoRA kết hợp nền tảng được lượng tử hóa 4-bit với bộ adapter hiệu chỉnh hiệu quả tham số.
QLoRA thường tiết kiệm bộ nhớ hơn so với fine-tuning đầy đủ độ chính xác trên cùng quy mô.
Cả LoRA và QLoRA đều thuộc nhóm phương pháp fine-tuning hiệu quả tham số.

items.query: Mô hình ReAct áp dụng cho tác nhân LLM như thế nào?
gold_claims: ReAct xen kẽ suy luận bằng ngôn ngữ với hành động gọi công cụ hoặc tương tác môi trường.
ReAct cho phép quan sát phản hồi sau mỗi hành động trước khi tiếp tục.
ReAct khác với chuỗi suy luận thuần túy không thực hiện hành động bên ngoài.
ReAct nhắm tới tác nhân đa bước cần lập kế hoạch và hành động.

items.query: LangGraph khác gì so với pipeline LangChain tuyến tính cho agent?
gold_claims: LangGraph biểu diễn luồng điều khiển dạng đồ thị có thể có vòng lặp.
LangGraph hỗ trợ trạng thái tường minh giữa các bước của agent.
LangGraph phục vụ các workflow agent có nhánh và lặp phức tạp hơn DAG đơn giản.

items.query: Constitutional AI là gì trong bài báo Constitutional AI của Anthropic?
gold_claims: Constitutional AI dùng nguyên tắc dạng hiến pháp để định hướng phản hồi và chỉnh sửa mô hình.
Constitutional AI khai thác phản hồi từ AI để giảm nhu cầu gán nhãn con người cho mọi ví dụ.
Constitutional AI nhắm tới mô hình ít gây hại hơn nhờ quy trình alignment có giám sát bằng nguyên tắc.
Constitutional AI liên quan tới kỹ thuật alignment nhằm cải thiện độ vô hại của LLM.
